Create an EDI Index Object

Source: R/edi_index.R
edi_index.Rd

Create an EDI Index Object

Usage

edi_index(x, ...)

Arguments

x

raw X12 text input

...

dots

Value

an <hcc::IndexEDI> S7 object

Details

Methods for edi_index:

  • ANY

  • character

  • hcc::IndexEDI

  • hcc::Text820

  • hcc::Text834

  • hcc::Text837

  • list

Examples

edi_index(x12_EX$`834`)
